long_description.EN: CAMPAIGN FINANCE RULES RELATED TO BOARD OF EDUCATION ELECTIONS. CHARTER AMENDMENT SC. Shall the Los Angeles City Charter be amended to clarify the campaign finance rules for Board of Education elections and allow for changes by ordinance? Supporters: Councilmember, Adrin Nazarian; LAUSD Board Member, Nick Melvoin; League of Women Voters of Greater LA; CA Common Cause Opponents: None submitted.
